HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Giant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants produce 10% more, but require 15% more sowing and harvest work.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Dwarf
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 10% faster and require 15% less sowing and harvest work, but produce 10% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Humongous
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants produce four times as much and need tree-like spacing, but require twice the sowing and harvest work.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Cold-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants tolerate temperatures 6 C colder at the low end, but their upper temperature range is 3 C narrower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Cold-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 8% faster, but need temperatures 6 C warmer at the low end.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Heat-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants tolerate temperatures 6 C hotter at the high end, but their lower temperature range begins 3 C higher.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Heat-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 8% faster, but stop growing 6 C sooner in heat.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Disease-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have half the blight chance, but grow 10% more slowly.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Disease-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 12% faster, but accept blight more readily and suffer extra blight damage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: High-Yield
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants produce 15% more, but grow 10% more slowly.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Low-Yield
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 15% faster, but produce 15% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants require 2 less growing skill to sow, but yield 5% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants yield 8% more, but require 2 more growing skill to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy Sow
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take 25% less work to sow, but yield 5% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult Sow
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants yield 8% more, but take 35% more work to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take 25% less work to harvest, but yield 5% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants yield 8% more, but take 35% more work to harvest.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants require a delivered resource before growth begins; once fulfilled, the selected subtype grows 15% faster.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Mulch)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, deliver one wood as mulch before growth begins; fulfilled plants then grow 15% faster.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Hay)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, deliver one hay as organic fertilizer before growth begins; fulfilled plants then grow 15% faster.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Fungus)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, deliver one raw fungus as fertilizer before growth begins; fulfilled plants then grow 15% faster.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Perennial
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants remain through regular harvest, reset to 30% growth, and become dormant in cold weather at 1% growth. Harvest yield is 70% and growth is 10% slower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Self-Seeding
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: At maturity, plants sow one adjacent valid empty cell, but harvest yield is 20% lower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Delicate
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 10% faster and have a taller, thinner habit, but have 25% fewer hit points.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Robust
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have 25% more hit points and a squat, broad habit, but grow 10% more slowly and take 10% more harvest work.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Very Delicate
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow 25% faster, but have very few hit points and take damage whenever a pawn or animal walks over them.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Forage
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wild animals find the standing plant especially nutritious and attractive; harvest yield is 10% higher, increasing the attraction's value and risk.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Fish-Habitat
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Mature plants near fishing water increase fishing yield by 25%, but crop yield is 15% lower and the plant requires an aquatic zone.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Aquatic Forage
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Fish gain 15% fishing yield from these aquatic plants, but crop yield is 20% lower and the plant requires an aquatic zone.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Aquatic
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants can only be cultivated in aquatic growing zones; the exclusive habitat is the specialization's tradeoff.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Desert
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants can only be cultivated in sandy growing zones; the exclusive habitat is the specialization's tradeoff.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Synergy
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants gain 115% of a selected stat near a selected plant type, but only 90% without that companion.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Byproduct
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvesting may also produce a configurable secondary product, at the cost of 10% primary harvest yield in variants.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Byproduct (Hay)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvesting may also produce a small amount of hay, but primary harvest yield is 10% lower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants develop resin with a contact effect; each variant pairs that risk with a mechanical benefit.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Joyresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Yellow resin gives handlers a short mood boost after sowing or harvesting, but harvest takes 10% more work.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Painresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Black resin causes temporary pain when handled, but the plant has 25% more hit points.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Burnresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Red resin can burn handlers, but the plant tolerates 2 C more heat.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Toxresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Green resin causes toxic buildup when handled, but blight chance is 10% lower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Thorny
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants may scratch a harvester's hand, but have 25% more hit points.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Beautiful
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have a soft golden radiance and improve surrounding beauty, but yield 10% less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ugly
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants emit unhealthy gloom and reduce surrounding beauty, but yield 10% more.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Produce Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's produce and harvested produce layers.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Leaf Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's leaf layer.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Stem Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's stem layer.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Nutritious (+%)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvested produce provides a generated percentage of additional nutrition, with matching harvest-work costs.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Highly Medicinal
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvested medicine has 15% greater medical potency, but crop yield is 15% lower.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Compound
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Produce develops a compound with an effect when eaten raw or as an ingredient in prepared food; variants have a matching produce tradeoff.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Compound (Joycompound)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Produce contains a pleasant compound that gives a temporary mood boost when eaten raw or in prepared food, but has 10% lower produce nutrition.
